length15_three_moves.map_rule: At every listed block start: order+1 for free, 0x80|(order+1) for allocated. All other 32-byte map positions are zero.
length15_three_moves.link_rule: For list [a0,...,az], ai.previous is ai-1 or NULL at head; ai.next is ai+1 or NULL at tail. All unlisted class heads are NULL.
length15_three_moves.canonicality: Complete disjoint dyadic cover; every free block's same-order sibling is allocated or subdivided with an allocated member.
